Page No.# 2/3 This is an application under Section 482 of the Code of Bharatiya Naragrik Surakha Sanhita, 2023 (as amended up to date) seeking anticipatory bail by the petitioners namely (1)

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the present petitioners are innocent and they are in no way connected with the offence alleged in the F.I.R.
Moreso, the incident happened in the year, 2009 and the F.I.R. was lodged on 06.06.2024 after a lapse of at least 15 (fifteen) years.
The petitioner is shown as member of the association of Himalaya Socio-Economic Development Sangstha.
However, he submits that only to recover the money, the complinant may approach the civil Court.
However, the petitioner is ready and willing to cooperate with the investigation if he is enlaraged on interim pre-arrest bail.

In this context, Mr. Sarma, the learned Addl. Public Prosecutor has submitted that it a case where huge amount of money has been misappropriated by the present accused/ petitioner alongwith the others and he has already collected money from 2,000 to 3,000/ people with an assurance to return the money alongwith 6% interest per annum.
The learned Addl. P.P. has submitted that the case diary will reflect the actual facts of the case.
Accordingly, call for the case diary, fixing 05.08.2024.

Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and considering the other aspects of the matter, this Court is of the view that privilege of interim pre-arrest bail may be granted to the petitioners till receipt of the case diary.

Accordingly it is provided that till next date, in the event of arrest of the petitioners in connection with the aforementioned case, they shall be released on interim pre-arrest bail on furnishing a bond of Rs. 20,000/- each with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority subject to the following conditions that:-
1. the petitioners shall appear before the I.O. within 7 days from today from today.
2. the petitioners shall make themselves available for interrogation by the Investigating Officer as and when required;
3. the petitioners shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him/
Page No.# 3/3 her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any other police officer,
and 4. the petitioners shall not hamper the investigation or temper with the evidence of the case.
List the matter 05.08.2024 for production of case diary.
